episode_definition: Saved 60Hz frames cross the current required gate plane from <=0 to >0 without a credit or rescue. Positions are rounded measurements; contact separation can also cause an uncredited crossing. These are descriptive exposures, not proof of a short recoverable miss.
design_limits: This first live pilot tests miss prevention and a physically feasible misaligned start. It cannot establish recovery from every already-passed gate pose. Exogenous matched post-miss restart would need a separately qualified harness. No significance or general reliability claim from two duel pairs.
